bugs.error_message: press-A glyph meshes jumbled/illegible in plume_native (placement correct)
bugs.root_cause: Per-draw vertex fetch base dropped: D3DDevice_SetStreamSource (0x82370E48) writes base=vb->format0+OffsetInBytes into device word +0x6F8 (stream 0), but both transports (SetStreamSourceNative header read, PM4 hook vbRes+0x18) used the offset-LESS header base, so every glyph bound the pool base. Pool content itself was byte-identical to the good xenos backend (T block found +164488 past bound base).
bugs.fix: TryDrawTimeRangedSnapshot reads the LIVE stream-0 fetch constant from device+0x6F8/+0x6FC at draw time (kUseLiveVertexFetchBase=true) and windows from that base. User-verified legible.

bugs.error_message: press-A background/A-button/logo textures render black in plume_native
bugs.root_cause: ApplyLiveTexturesFromContext preferred surface-aperture entries over translating the fetch constant; a misregistered resolve destination (Resolve hook dest+32 decode unreliable for some call shapes, e.g. dest=0x2E023900 -> dataBase=0x0AAE0000 = the BC1 art's page) mapped the art's page to a black RT surface, so sampler slot 0 bound the RT instead of the art every frame.
bugs.fix: BC gate: translate the fetch first; a block-compressed result can never be a resolve product, so aperture entries may not shadow it. Plus resolveDest-only aperture lookups for sampling and a BC-dest refusal in the Resolve hook. Verified: slot0 now binds the BC1 art at the same base the xenos-good capture samples. Background still black -> remaining issue is downstream (descriptor index at draw / blend / BC1 alpha), open.

bugs.error_message: press-A textured quads still black after correct texture binding: wrong/smeared pixel shader
bugs.root_cause: All UI quad draws bind ONE pixel shader (no float-constant block) while the good xenos backend alternates per draw (d88fa0db textured tint-chain for bg/shadows, 2e856b2a for A-button). The tint-chain multiplies the sample by PS float constants; with the wrong PS the output is black regardless of texture. Guest stores the live PS object at ctx+0x307C (D3DDevice_SetPixelShader 0x8236DD10).
bugs.fix: PARTIAL: ApplyLivePixelShaderFromContext reads ctx+0x307C per draw (verified varying pointers) but visuals unchanged -- ResolveShader/LookupShaderAlias likely returns null for these PS objects (created via Fm2LoadPixelShaderResourceById, never alias-registered). OPEN: log resolved ptr, register aliases at load-by-id, then wire precompiled-CB constant fixup hooks for the PS float constants.

bugs.error_message: UI material state (PS program + tint float constants) invisible to plume transport: travels inside PLAYED precompiled command buffers executed as PM4 INDIRECT_BUFFER calls
bugs.root_cause: D3D_SubmitCommandBuffer (sub_82372920) links played blobs into the ring as INDIRECT_BUFFER (0xC0013F00) packets; the pre-draw ring scanner never followed IBs, and segments contain further NESTED IBs. Shader programs ride as IM_LOAD_IMMEDIATE (op 0x2B, inline ucode) inside the inner buffers, so ctx+0x307C never sees the material PS either.
bugs.fix: PARTIAL: hooked sub_82372920 with ScanSubmittedSegment (packet-structured walk, recurses nested IBs depth<=3) feeding ScanPm4AluConstantRange -> constants now reach the shadow in record order. OPEN: map IM_LOAD/IM_LOAD_IMMEDIATE ucode to translated GuestShaders (ucode-hash + address-interval index built at CreateShaderFromFunction) and apply rr::SetPixelShader from the scan.
